pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Wearing Her Original Hooded Jacket at the Hidden Leaf Village Gate Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hinata Hyuga wearing her original hooded jacket at the Hidden Leaf Village gate, standing with her hands held shyly together. Fluffy cuffs, a neck-worn forehead protector, a thigh pouch, cropped trousers, and open-toed sandals frame her pose beneath the large Leaf emblem.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga in Her Naruto Shippuden Outfit Overlooking Konoha From a Rooftop Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga overlooks Konoha from a rooftop in this printable coloring page, wearing her Naruto Shippuden outfit with long straight hair flowing past her shoulders. Her hooded jacket, neck protector, thigh straps, and sandals stand before layered village rooftops, trees, and the carved faces of Hokage Rock.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Activating Her Byakugan Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hinata Hyuga activating her Byakugan, standing with a serious expression and branching veins drawn beside her pale, focused eyes. Her long hair, hooded jacket, mesh neckline, Leaf neck protector, thigh pouch, and open-toed sandals remain clearly outlined against the plain background.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Practicing the Gentle Fist Stance in the Hyuga Courtyard Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga practices the Gentle Fist stance in the Hyuga courtyard in this printable coloring page, extending one open palm while holding the other near her waist. Her long hair and hooded jacket follow the wide-legged pose, with stepping stones, bushes, grass, and a tiled boundary wall behind her.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Forming Gentle Step Twin Lion Fists Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hinata Hyuga forming Gentle Step Twin Lion Fists, with two fierce lion-shaped chakra outlines surrounding her clenched hands. Her long hair streams sideways above the hooded jacket and thigh pouch, while flame-like curves, open lion jaws, and a wide stance emphasize the action.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Performing Eight Trigrams Sixty-four Palms Over a Trigram Circle Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga performs Eight Trigrams Sixty-four Palms over a trigram circle in this printable coloring page, reaching one open hand toward the viewer with focused eyes. Her other palm stays near her chest, while long flowing hair, jacket folds, thigh straps, and sandals frame the circular patterned platform.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Using Eight Trigrams Vacuum Palm to Strike a Distant Training Target Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hinata Hyuga using Eight Trigrams Vacuum Palm to strike a distant training target, extending one arm from a wide grounded stance. Expanding curved waves travel toward the wooden practice post, with her streaming hair, hooded jacket, distant shrubs, stones, and grass completing the training field.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Creating a Protecting Eight Trigrams Sixty Four Palms Barrier Against Bees Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga creates a Protecting Eight Trigrams Sixty Four Palms barrier against bees in this printable coloring page, holding both palms outward inside a swirling dome. Her short hair and fluffy-trimmed jacket sit within sweeping energy lines, while several striped bees hover outside the rounded protective shape.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Training Chakra Control Beside a Waterfall in Her Ninja Outfit Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hinata Hyuga training chakra control beside a waterfall, balancing in a wide stance on rocks with both open palms raised. Her short-haired ninja outfit includes a fluffy-trimmed jacket and neck protector, with falling water, river ripples, boulders, trees, and bushes framing the practice scene.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Releasing a Messenger Owl During Team 8's War Mission Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga releases a messenger owl during Team 8's war mission in this printable coloring page, extending one hand as the bird spreads its wings above her. A pocketed flak jacket, thigh pouch, wrapped lower legs, and sandals distinguish her outfit among camp tents, wooden crates, and distant bushes.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Attending the Ninja Academy with Young Naruto Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hinata Hyuga attending the Ninja Academy with young Naruto, the two sitting at neighboring desks and smiling toward each other. Hinata folds her hands beside a blank paper, while Naruto rests his chin on one fist before the classroom board and tall windows.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Sparring with Hiashi Hyuga at the Family Dojo Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga spars with Hiashi Hyuga at the family dojo in this printable coloring page, copying his open-palm stance with her knees bent and feet apart. Hiashi's long hair and belted robe contrast with young Hinata's short hair and jacket, framed by wooden floorboards and plain paneled walls.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Meeting Young Neji at Her Third Birthday Celebration Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hinata Hyuga meeting young Neji at her third birthday celebration, the two children smiling together inside a traditional paneled room. Flowers decorate Hinata's belted kimono, while Neji wears a loose robe with tied waist, with sliding screens, tatami-style flooring, and a flowering vase nearby.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Watching Young Naruto Train From Behind a Wooden Post Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga watches young Naruto train from behind a wooden post in this printable coloring page, peeking around its edge while he throws a determined punch. Naruto's clenched fists and wide stance face another tall log, with trees, bushes, a wooden fence, and village towers behind the training ground.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Sitting Beside Naruto During the Chunin Exams Written Test Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hinata Hyuga sitting beside Naruto during the Chunin Exams written test, both holding pencils above papers on a shared classroom desk. Their Leaf protectors, zipped jackets, cropped trousers, and open-toed sandals add character detail as Hinata glances toward Naruto and he smiles back.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Offering Naruto Healing Ointment After His Fight with Kiba Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga offers Naruto healing ointment after his fight with Kiba in this printable coloring page, kneeling beside him with a small jar extended between her hands. Naruto sits on the grass and reaches toward it, with their Leaf protectors, trees, shrubs, and a wooden fence framing the quiet exchange.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Fighting Neji in the Chunin Exam Arena Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hinata Hyuga fighting Neji in the Chunin Exam arena, both holding open-palm stances with bent knees and their eyes focused. Hinata's hooded jacket contrasts with Neji's short-sleeved top and wrapped forearm, while the arena's cracked wall panels and tiled floor surround the pair.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Encouraging Naruto at the Training Field Before the Chunin Exam Finals Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga encourages Naruto before the Chunin Exam finals in this printable coloring page, sitting beside him on a wooden bench at the training field. They smile toward each other with hands resting near their knees, framed by rope-wrapped practice posts, bushes, grass, and a tall wooden fence.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Watching Naruto Leave Konoha with Jiraiya Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hinata Hyuga watching Naruto leave Konoha with Jiraiya, standing beside the open village gates with her hands clasped against her jacket. The travelers walk away along a tree-lined road, with Jiraiya's large back scroll, distant mountains, and small clouds extending into the background.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Shyly Greeting Naruto When He Returns to Konoha Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga shyly greets Naruto when he returns to Konoha in this printable coloring page, holding her hands together while he smiles with one hand behind his head. Their older ninja outfits stand along a paved street, with wooden buildings, steps, trees, and a Leaf-marked tower behind them.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Posing with Kiba, Shino, and Akamaru as Team 8 Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hinata Hyuga posing with Kiba, Shino, and Akamaru as Team 8, her hand resting near the protector around her neck. Kiba folds his arms beside the smiling dog, while Shino's round glasses and high-collared coat distinguish the standing group against a plain background.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Receiving Mission Instructions From Kurenai Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga receives mission instructions from Kurenai in this printable coloring page, accepting a rolled scroll as the taller ninja stands beside an office desk. Kurenai's long wavy hair, forehead protector, mesh sleeves, and wrapped outfit contrast with Hinata's fluffy-trimmed jacket beneath the Leaf emblem on the wall.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Petting Akamaru Beside Kiba Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hinata Hyuga petting Akamaru beside Kiba, bending forward with one hand resting above the happy dog's fluffy head. Kiba watches with his hands in his jacket pockets, while Leaf protectors, a wooden fence, leafy trees, shrubs, and a distant village tower surround the group.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Searching for the Bikochu Beetle Among Forest Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga searches for the Bikochu beetle among forest leaves in this printable coloring page, reaching one finger toward a small insect resting on a broad leaf. Her short hair and fluffy-trimmed jacket stand between tall trunks, leafy shrubs, grass, and scattered fallen foliage on the narrow woodland path.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Following an Enemy Trail with Shino and His Insects Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hinata Hyuga following an enemy trail with Shino and his insects, leaning forward to point toward several beetles along the path. Shino walks beside her in round glasses and a tall-collared coat, with dense trees, shrubs, rocks, and grass bordering the forest route.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Scouting a Forest Path with Her Byakugan Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga scouts a forest path with her Byakugan in this printable coloring page, standing alert with one hand at her hip beneath her long straight hair. Fine veins mark her focused eyes, while her hooded outfit, neck protector, rocks, bushes, and distant tree-covered hills fill the woodland setting.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Combining Eight Trigrams Vacuum Wall Palm with Neji Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hinata Hyuga combining Eight Trigrams Vacuum Wall Palm with Neji, both reaching forward from wide stances beneath a sweeping ring of energy. Matching pocketed flak jackets, wrapped lower legs, thigh pouches, and windblown hair distinguish the two focused ninjas within the broad, jagged chakra curves.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Forming the Four-corner Sealing Barrier with Sakura, Ino, and Shizune Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga forms the Four-corner Sealing Barrier with Sakura, Ino, and Shizune in this printable coloring page, holding a hand sign at the shoreline. The other three ninjas stand on rippling water beyond her, joined by straight barrier lines, with distant trees and mountains across the broad lake.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Confronting Pain to Protect Naruto in Ruined Konoha Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hinata Hyuga confronting Pain to protect Naruto in ruined Konoha, standing between them with an open palm raised toward Pain. Naruto sits behind her among broken masonry, while Pain's cloud-patterned cloak, shattered buildings, fallen beams, and a damaged Leaf sign fill the devastated village.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Wearing an Allied Shinobi Forces Flak Jacket at the War Camp Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga wears an Allied Shinobi Forces flak jacket at the war camp in this printable coloring page, standing with her hands gently folded before her. Rectangular vest pockets, thigh straps, leg wraps, and sandals add uniform detail, with a large tent, stacked crate, and buckled bedroll behind her.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Defending Neji From a White Zetsu Clone Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hinata Hyuga defending Neji from a White Zetsu clone, taking a wide stance with one open palm held toward the approaching figure. Neji rests on one knee behind her, while matching flak jackets, windblown hair, broken rocks, and jagged battlefield ridges frame the confrontation.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Holding Naruto's Hand on the Battlefield Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga holds Naruto's hand on the battlefield in this printable coloring page, standing beside him with a gentle smile and her long hair falling straight. Naruto's marked outfit is edged by flame-shaped chakra, while Hinata's flak jacket, wrapped legs, sandals, and the rocky ground provide clear costume and setting details.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Using Sixty-four Palms Against a Ten-tails Clone Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hinata Hyuga using Sixty-four Palms against a Ten-tails clone, driving one open hand toward the large creature's chest with a sharp impact burst. Her flowing hair, flak jacket, bent knees, and grounded sandals contrast with the clone's towering body, pointed back growths, and open mouth.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Knitting Naruto's Scarf in the Last Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga knits Naruto's scarf in The Last in this printable coloring page, sitting on a wooden bench with two needles and a long patterned scarf. A ball of yarn rests beside her winter coat, while fringe, bare branches, village rooftops, and the carved Hokage faces complete the quiet outdoor scene.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Wearing Her the Last Mission Outfit at a Moon Cave Entrance Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hinata Hyuga wearing her mission outfit from The Last at a moon cave entrance, holding one hand near her sleeveless neckline. A broad waist sash, short layered tunic, thigh straps, and open-toed boots stand against uneven cave walls, scattered stones, and large foreground rocks.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Finding Hanabi's Kunai During the Rescue Mission Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga finds Hanabi's kunai during the rescue mission in this printable coloring page, kneeling on a forest path and reaching toward the blade's ring handle. Her long hair falls forward beside her sleeveless outfit, with tall trees, exposed roots, boulders, shrubs, pebbles, and grass surrounding the discovery.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Speaking with Hamura Otsutsuki in the Ancestral Shrine Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hinata Hyuga speaking with Hamura Otsutsuki in the ancestral shrine, looking up as the tall, robed figure extends one open hand. His long hair, hornlike head features, and patterned robe stand beneath a broad shrine gate, with circular wall details, steps, and railings behind them.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Wearing Toneri's Ceremonial Bridal Dress in His Moon Palace Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga wears Toneri's ceremonial bridal dress in his moon palace in this printable coloring page, standing with her hands folded beneath a large crescent-marked headdress. Long flowing veil panels, a high collar, detached sleeves, tassels, and a crescent belt ornament echo the huge circular palace design behind her.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Joining Naruto to Destroy the Tenseigan Energy Vessel Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hinata Hyuga joining Naruto to destroy the Tenseigan energy vessel, both pressing their palms toward the large cracked sphere between them. Wavy chakra outlines surround their hands, while focused faces, bent knees, a stepped pedestal, and radial floor markings frame the shared action.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Hugging Hanabi After Rescuing Her From Toneri Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga hugs Hanabi after rescuing her from Toneri in this printable coloring page, wrapping both arms around her younger sister as they smile together. Their long straight hair and contrasting sleeveless and wide-sleeved outfits frame the embrace, with waist sashes, thigh straps, and open-toed footwear clearly outlined.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Giving Naruto the Scarf She Knitted Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hinata Hyuga giving Naruto the scarf she knitted, each holding part of the long patterned fabric on a snowy village path. Dense stitches and fringe distinguish the gift, while bare branches, snow-covered bushes, wooden railings, and distant buildings frame their gentle smiles.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Sharing a Kiss with Naruto Beneath the Full Moon Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga shares a kiss with Naruto beneath the full moon in this printable coloring page, resting one hand on his shoulder as they stand together. Her long hair and tied waist sash fall beside his high-collared outfit, with a railing, distant hills, clouds, and tiled paving surrounding the couple.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Wearing Her Wedding Kimono Beside Naruto at Their Ceremony Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hinata Hyuga wearing her wedding kimono beside Naruto at their ceremony, the couple standing together beneath a flower-decorated fabric arch. Blossoms cover Hinata's long train and elaborate hairpiece, while Naruto's formal robe, pleated trousers, decorative cords, and the surrounding bouquets add ceremonial detail.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Holding Flowers Beside Sakura in a Konoha Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga holds flowers beside Sakura in a Konoha garden in this printable coloring page, both smiling as they cradle matching bouquets near their waists. Their distinct ninja outfits and hairstyles stand among a stream, small bridge, rocks, flowering shrubs, trees, and village towers marked with the Leaf emblem.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Cooking Dinner in the Uzumaki Family Kitchen Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hinata Hyuga cooking dinner in the Uzumaki family kitchen, stirring a large pot while resting her other hand on the counter. Her short hair and casual hooded jacket frame the domestic scene, with utensils, a cooker hood, sink, potted plant, cupboards, and a window nearby.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Helping Boruto Prepare for the Ninja Academy Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga helps Boruto prepare for the Ninja Academy in this printable coloring page, adjusting his jacket as he grips the straps of his backpack. Their smiling faces and casual hooded outfits fill the doorway, with Boruto's spiky hair, whisker marks, thigh pouch, and open-toed sandals adding recognizable details.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Caring for Himawari While She Rests in Bed Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Hinata Hyuga caring for Himawari while she rests in bed, gently holding a folded cloth against her daughter's forehead. Himawari smiles beneath a broad blanket, while a bedside bowl, wooden stool, curved headboard, window, and tied curtain frame the quiet family scene.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Celebrating Himawari's Birthday with Boruto and Naruto Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga celebrates Himawari's birthday with Boruto and Naruto in this printable coloring page, gathering around a candle-topped cake on a cloth-covered round table. Himawari sits at the center with her hands near her cheeks, while Hinata and Naruto rest gentle hands beside her and Boruto smiles nearby.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga Posing for an Uzumaki Family Photo with Naruto, Boruto, and Himawari Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hinata Hyuga posing for an Uzumaki family photo with Naruto, Boruto, and Himawari, all four smiling toward the viewer. Naruto stands behind Boruto with his arm around Hinata, while Himawari's clasped hands, Boruto's folded arms, and their detailed everyday outfits distinguish each family member.

pages.title: Hinata Hyuga in Chibi Form Holding a Plate of Cinnamon Rolls Coloring Page
pages.description: Hinata Hyuga appears in chibi form holding a plate of cinnamon rolls in this printable coloring page, smiling softly above three large spiral-topped pastries. Her oversized head, long straight hair, Leaf neck protector, zipped jacket, thigh pouch, and open-toed sandals remain clearly outlined against a plain background.

pages.title: Naruto Hinata Chibi Cat Onesie Free Printable Coloring Page for Kids
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows chibi Hinata sitting in a cat onesie, raising both hands like paws beneath a hood with ears and whisker markings. Her costume has a curled tail, front buttons, and paw-print soles. The Leaf Village symbol hangs at her neck, adding a small detail among the larger clothing sections.

pages.title: Naruto Chibi Hinata Akatsuki Cloak Free Printable Coloring Page for Kids
pages.description: Chibi Hinata wears an Akatsuki cloak in this printable coloring page, standing with her arms slightly spread and long straight hair framing her oversized eyes. Outlined cloud emblems decorate the high-collared cloak. Small flowers and dots surround her, while the open garment panels and simple sandals provide larger sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Naruto Hinata in Village Market Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Naruto and Hinata together in a village market, smiling as Naruto rests one arm around her shoulder beside the wooden stalls. Hinata wears a fringed scarf beneath her neck protector, with shop awnings, blank hanging signs, produce displays, and background shoppers completing the busy street.

pages.title: Naruto Hinata in Academy Courtyard Coloring Page
pages.description: Naruto and Hinata stand in an academy courtyard in this printable coloring page, smiling side by side with their Leaf protectors worn at forehead and neck. Their short-haired younger designs contrast with the tall school building, while a wooden bench, trees, fence posts, grass, and scattered paving stones surround them.

pages.title: Naruto Hinata in Ancient Ruins Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Naruto and Hinata visiting ancient ruins, standing close together as Naruto rests one arm around her shoulder and one hand at his hip. Carved stone arches, cracked block walls, a fluted column, broken steps, and loose rubble surround their smiling faces and detailed ninja outfits.

pages.title: Naruto Hinata in Frozen Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: Naruto and Hinata explore a frozen valley in this printable coloring page, posing together between steep cliffs edged with snow and long hanging icicles. Hinata clasps her hands and closes her eyes with a smile, while Naruto's spiky hair, their Leaf protectors, fir trees, scattered rocks, and distant peaks complete the scene.

pages.title: Naruto Hinata in Hidden Leaf Village Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Naruto and Hinata embracing in the Hidden Leaf Village, smiling toward the viewer with their arms resting around each other. Their zipped jackets, thigh straps, and Leaf protectors stand above the street's wooden boards, with tiled rooftops, trees, mountains, and carved Hokage faces behind them.
